## Xvalue

```{r, echo=FALSE}
### Load spectra
dirs <- list.dirs(paste0(d0, "spectres/"), recursive = FALSE) %>%
  basename() %>%                     # recup le nom des dossiers
  as_tibble() %>%                    # tibble pour dyplr
  filter(grepl("_Vita", value)) %>%  
  filter(!grepl("HR", value)) %>%    
  pull(value)                        # retours sous forme de liste 

### merge de tous les campagnes de spectres
Xvalue <- merge(vitaspec_load(paste0(d0,"spectres/"),
                       dirs[1]),
                vitaspec_load(paste0(d0,"spectres/"),
                       dirs[2]),
                by="spname",
                all=TRUE)

for (i in 3:(length(dirs))) { Xvalue <- merge(Xvalue,
                                              vitaspec_load(paste0(d0,"spectres/"),
                                                            dirs[i]),
                                              by="spname",
                                              all=TRUE)}

### clean des spectres sans nom (erreur manip)
Xvalue <- Xvalue %>%
  filter(!str_detect(spname, "Spectrum")) %>% 
  mutate(
    ech = sub("-.*", "", spname),
    rep = as.numeric(substr(spname, 
                            nchar(spname)-4, 
                            nchar(spname)
                            )))
  
### ajout colonne "état"
Xvalue <- Xvalue %>%
  mutate(etat = case_when(
    # exo = Pobe et contient X
    (!is.na(x20240325_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1]) | !is.na(x20250224_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1])) & grepl("X", spname) ~ "Exo",

    # meso_frais = Pobe présentes et ne contient pas X
    (!is.na(x20240325_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1]) | !is.na(x20250224_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1])) & !grepl("X", spname) ~ "Meso_frais",

    # Mso_silica = 
    (!is.na(x20240405_VitaSPEC_S_DIADE[,1]) | !is.na(x20250313_Vitaspec_S_DIADE[,1])) ~ "Meso_Silica",

    # meso_Lyoph = 
    (!is.na(x20250319_Vitaspec_Lyoph_DIADE[,1]) | !is.na(x20250321_Vitaspec_Lyoph_DIADE[,1])) ~ "Meso_Lyoph",

    # si aucune condition 
    TRUE ~ NA_character_))

Xvalue <- Xvalue %>% 
  rename_with(~ str_remove_all(.x, "(?i)_Vitaspec"))
```

## CV
```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
fm_all=list()
id_model=list()
#idparam <- "meso_frais"
idparam <- "meso_silica"

#source(paste0(d0,"vitaspec_R/ROSA_vitaSPEC/list_pre_beta_carot.R"))

compose_etudie <- ag#[-c(1:10,12:16)]
print(compose_etudie)

compose_etudie %>%
  walk(function(ag1) {
    print(ag1)
    datok <- dat %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[ag1]]))

    y_vals <- as.numeric(datok[[ag1]])
    x_mat  <- as.matrix(datok$x)

    try({
      vitaspec_preCV(
        x = x_mat,
        y = y_vals,
        fun = "plskern",
        list_pre = list_pre,
        ncomp = 15,
        titl = "Meso_sec",
        y_name = ag1
      )
    })
  })
```

# Calibration finale
```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
fm_all=list()
id_model=list()
#idparam <- "meso_frais"
idparam <- "meso_silica"

compose_etudie %>% 
  walk(function(ag1) {
    print(ag1)
    datok <- dat %>% 
      filter(!is.na(.data[[ag1]]))
  
    y_vals <- as.numeric(datok[[ag1]])
    x_mat  <- as.matrix(datok$x)

    try({
      vitaspec_preCV(
        x = x_mat, 
        y = y_vals, 
        fun = "plskern", 
        list_pre = list_pre, 
        ncomp = 15, 
        titl = "Meso_sec",
        y_name = ag1
      )
    })
    current_param <- param %>%
      filter(str_detect(Cal_data, fixed(idparam)),  
             str_trim(Propriete) == str_trim(ag1))

    if (nrow(current_param) == 0) {
      warning(paste("error no", idparam, "for", ag1,"found"))
    } else {
      p <- eval(parse(text = current_param$pre))
      n_lv <- current_param$nvl
  
      fm_finale <- plskern(
        pre(x_mat, p),
        y_vals,
        nlv = n_lv
        )
      fm_all <<- append(fm_all, list(fm_finale))
      id_model <<- id_model %>%
      bind_rows(tibble(Propriete = ag1,
                       Condition = idparam))
      }
    }
  )

save(fm_all, id_model, file = paste0(d0, "vitaspec_R/Vitaspec_fruit_models_3_sec"))
```

# prediction de nouveaux échantillons
```{r}
load(paste0(d0,"vitaspec_R/Vitaspec_fruit_models_3_sec"))

idparam <- "meso_silica" 
titre <- "SEC_26_NIRS_TEST_Meso_SEC"


load(paste0(d0, "vitaspec_R/Vitaspec_fruit_models_3_sec"))
param <- read.csv(paste0(d0, "vitaspec_R/Vitaspec_fruit_param.csv"))

# spectres a predire

f <- paste0(d0, "spectres/20260304_Vitaspec_S_DIADE")
spnew <- asd_read_dir(f)
spnew <- spnew[!grepl("X", rownames(spnew)), ]

param_filtre <- param %>% 
  filter(grepl(idparam, Cal_data))

# prédiction

pred <- tibble(spname = rownames(spnew))
nag <- nrow(param_filtre)

for (i in 1:nag) {
  p <- eval(parse(text = param_filtre$pre[i]))
  spnx <- pre(spnew, p)
  
  prop <- param_filtre$Propriete[i]
  
  imodel <- which(grepl(idparam, id_model$Condition) & grepl(prop, id_model$Propriete))
  
  pred_val <- predict(fm_all[[imodel]], spnx)$pred
  pred <- pred %>% 
    mutate(!!prop := as.vector(pred_val))
}

# stats par échantillon
pred <- pred %>%
  mutate(ech = sub("-.*", "", spname)) %>%
  relocate(ech, spname)

# moy par échantillon
pred_moy <- pred %>%
  select(-spname) %>%
  group_by(ech) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

# stats descriptives
pred_stats <- pred %>%
  select(-spname) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -ech, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Valeur") %>%
  group_by(ech, Variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(Valeur, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(Valeur, na.rm = TRUE),
    min  = min(Valeur, na.rm = TRUE),
    max  = max(Valeur, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#export
write_xlsx(pred, paste0(d0, "vitaspec_R/ROSA_vitaSPEC/predictions/", titre, "_pred.xlsx"))
write_xlsx(pred_moy, paste0(d0, "vitaspec_R/ROSA_vitaSPEC/predictions/", titre, "_pred_moy.xlsx"))
write_xlsx(pred_stats, paste0(d0, "vitaspec_R/ROSA_vitaSPEC/predictions/", titre, "_pred_stats.xlsx"))
```
